sources.notes: The list states a general stay of under 30 days and lists agreements covering ordinary passports for the countries above (Dominica: agreement in force since 2022-09-19, per the Chinese-language table). It also lists ordinary-passport agreements for Albania, Armenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Mauritius and San Marino but does not state their 60/90-day stays, so those are not linked.
